Call (888) 625-7525. explore the collection / Destinations / Laguna Beach, California / 4 / 4Show Thumbnails Laguna Beach, California The artsy enclave of Laguna Beach is the perfect getaway in Southern California. Situated on a bluff above the Pacific, you can't get much closer to the ocean than at Montage Laguna Beach. Take a dip in one of the outdoor pools, relax with a massage in the spa, or watch the sunset over the water from your private balcony or patio at this luxury resort. Please note: we offer incredible members-only pricing at Montage Laguna Beach. Select your travel dates and click book to view members only rates in the cart. Questions? We're here to help. Our expert travel advisors will help you find the perfect trip. Contact Us Sitting on the coast between Los Angeles and San Diego, Laguna Beach is a destination that has something for everyone. Art lovers can peruse the 100+ galleries and studios throughout town or plan a trip during one of Laguna's famous festivals. Traveling with the family? Kids love exploring the tidal pools and sea caves along the coast. Adventure seekers can get on the water or go hiking or mountain biking in the nearby protected wilderness areas—and you'll be rewarded with some beautiful ocean views. This small, SoCal town is a wonderful place to spend your vacation relaxing on the beach all day and taking in a beautiful sunset in the evening. Quick Facts Suggested airport John Wayne Airport, Orange County (SNA) Average temperature 78°F Summer/68°F Winter Closest big city Los Angeles Car recommended? Yes Average water temperature 65°F Destination Highlights Arts Festival The Sawdust Art Festival—drawing art enthusiasts from around the world—and Pageant of the Masters, which has been held in Laguna for more than 80 years are just two of the annual festivals that are not to be missed. Outdoor Activities With everything from surfing and paddleboarding to hiking and mountain biking, Laguna Beach has a variety of activities for active travelers. Hike or drive to the Top of the World park for amazing views of the ocean. Beaches Laguna Beach is the only marine reserve in SoCal, which offers 7 miles of beautiful water, abundant sea life, and clean, sandy beaches. Main Beach is in the heart of town, while surfers love the waves at the south beaches. Loading... Weather Forecasting your Laguna Beach Vacation As a coastal town in Southern California, Laguna Beach sees mild weather year-round. During the cooler months, temperatures range from mid-to-upper 60s during the day and drop slightly into the mid-to-upper 50s at night. In the summer, temperatures are mostly in the 70s during the day and low 60s at night. Winter is slightly rainier, with February being the wettest month. In the late spring and early summer, "June gloom" rolls in and creates cloudy mornings that usually turn sunny by the afternoon.
